summary: This is an interactive story book that shows the stories of 5 machines NASA left behind the apollo 17 rover and science station on the Moon, NEAR shoemaker at asteroid Eros, Opportunity and Ingenuity on Mars, and Dawn at Ceres. This answers the challenge by showing what happened after a mission ends, the last signal, picture, and what each machine changed for us. This is important because these machines are easy to forget once people know about the information. Many people look at what NASA found out and not the journey that led to finding out those information.
details:
My Story is a web storybook where it like a book with different movies. On the first page, the reader answers one question. Five pages afterwards are for each machine. The apollo 17 rover and science station, NEAR shoemaker, Opportunity, Dawn, and Ingenuity.

When the reader opens a page about one of the machine, the NASA image zooms in and a story plays. This is like a short video that can be paused or skipped anytime. These scenes include timelines, photo scenes, a scanner panel with found parts, distance went, and additional facts. The text appears with a typewriter effect and when the user finishes a story, a stamp appears with a postmark on the page. All earned stamps through our the page appears all on the last page and when you click it, it enlarges.

This project is for school age and casual space fans. When a mission ends, the news are usually just a single line of the machines name along with all the accomplishments and founding, but this project turns into short stories about what each machine did, how it ended, and what it changed for us today.

Tools used:

- HTML, CSS, and Javascript

- Web animation API for book opening, page turn and stamps

- Google Fonts

- GitHub Pages

- NASA image and video library

- SI tool: Claude by Anthropic to research NASA pages, draft the story text, write the code, make slide deck and ChatGPT to generate the five stamp illustrations
